name: Electrovaya
description: Lithium-ion battery maker with a proprietary ceramic separator, serving material handling, energy storage, defense and robotics.
notes: HQ Mississauga per SEC annual info form (6688 Kitimat Rd). Long-established public company (about 30 years), borderline startup; kept as late stage.

name: Enertel AI
description: AI-driven probabilistic power price forecasting and bidding tools for North American wholesale electricity markets.
notes: Acquired by S&P Global (announced 2026-03-18). Toronto HQ per earlier sourcing (Built In, grant record).

name: Mutuo Health Solutions
description: Maker of AutoScribe, an AI medical scribe that transcribes clinician-patient conversations and generates medical notes.
notes: Site says it is a WELLSTAR company (possible parent; not confirmed as acquisition). Toronto address from CB Insights.

name: Autumn
description: Employee well-being measurement platform that assesses team wellness without traditional surveys (formerly Animo AI).
notes: Only aggregator data (CB Insights, unclaimed profile); no website found, current status unconfirmed. Toronto per CB Insights. Amount currency as reported by CB Insights.

name: BenchSci
description: AI-powered research platform (EMET) for drug discovery and pharmaceutical R&D.
notes: Stage Growth inferred from known Series D funding, not re-sourced this pass. Toronto HQ address from CB Insights/Datanyze.

name: BioRender.io
description: Scientific figure and illustration software used by over 4 million researchers.
notes: Toronto HQ (Ottawa office) per Clay and Built In.

name: BlueDot
description: Infectious disease intelligence company combining AI and public health experts to monitor outbreaks and forecast risk.
notes: Toronto HQ per Wikipedia (earlier sourcing); site gives no address.

name: Blue J Legal
description: AI-powered tax research platform delivering sourced answers for tax professionals.
notes: Toronto HQ per Dealroom/Stanford TechIndex; site also lists a New York office.
address: 225 King St W, Suite 1405, Toronto, ON M5V 3M2

name: Brodie Sports Group
description: Operator of Brodie Rec League, a recreational sports league with 50,000+ athletes across 35+ locations.
notes: Site lists Toronto WHQ. Founded 2019 per Built In. brodiesports.com redirects to brodierec.com.
address: 5-1050 King St W, Toronto, ON M6K 0C7

name: BuyProperly
description: AI-powered online platform for fractional investments in real estate and other private assets.
notes: Toronto-based per BetaKit 2021 and Built In (DMZ alumni), but the current US site page lists a San Jose, CA address; Toronto HQ not re-confirmed recently.

name: e-Zinc
description: Zinc-based long-duration energy storage developer.
notes: Toronto HQ per BetaKit; pilot plant in Mississauga. Street address not confirmed from site.

name: hungerhub
description: Office meal delivery and catering service in Canada.
notes: Acquired by HUNGRY (site: 'hungerhub is now part of HUNGRY'; Feb 2026 per earlier sourcing).

name: HyperComply
description: AI platform for completing security questionnaires and sharing security evidence via trust pages and data rooms.
notes: Acquired by SecurityScorecard (announced on company site). Toronto HQ per CB Insights/Built In/Dealroom; one source says NY.

name: Madlipz
description: Dubbing and singing app for creating short parody videos, with tens of millions of users worldwide.
notes: Toronto-based per BetaKit. Website returned HTTP 402 so activity not confirmed; round date approximate (2019, exact date not found, day set to 01 as placeholder). Founded 2015 per Techstars board (BetaKit says 2016 launch).

name: Manifest Climate
description: AI-powered assessment engine for sustainability disclosures against frameworks such as CSRD, ISSB and TCFD.
notes: HQ address from company site.
address: 33 Bloor St E, Suite 604, Toronto, ON M4W 3H1

name: Notch
description: Software and payments platform for restaurant supply chains (formerly ChefHero), digitizing invoicing and ordering between restaurants and distributors.
notes: Official website not found (notchfinancial.com is parked/for sale; notch.ca unreachable). Round of CAD 13.7M closed January 2023 (exact date/round name not confirmed). Stage and headcount (~40) from an aggregator, no 2025-2026 news found. Toronto lead office per Osler.

name: Powered By People
description: Commerce platform that connects independent and sustainable brands to retailers and AI shopping agents through dropship, catalog and verification tools.
notes: HQ not stated on company site (distributed team); Toronto per The Logic and Osler lead office, so GTA only moderately confirmed. A newer financing led by BESTSELLER Foundation was reported in Aug 2026 (amount undisclosed). Series A date per Osler (a French page gives 2023-03-10). poweredbypeople.ca redirects to an unrelated company (peoplecorporation.com).

name: Properly
description: Toronto real estate technology company offering home search and buy-before-you-sell services.
notes: Acquired by Pine (announced 2023-10-05); Sales Assurance IP sold separately to Compass. properly.ca now redirects to pine.ca.

name: ProteinQure
description: Clinical-stage biotech designing peptide therapeutics, with a lead program in Phase 1 for advanced solid tumors.
notes: Toronto HQ per Built In/Datanyze; one outlier source says Cambridge. Address from directories, not company site.

name: Rebelstork
description: Online retailer of discounted baby, home and kitchen products.
notes: rebelstork.com redirects to fromrebel.com (REBEL), taken as the same company via redirect. Toronto per Retail Insider (CEO); no address on site.

name: ReBlink
description: Applied AI research and development team building multi-agent systems, multimodal models and generative tools for games.
notes: Site lists HQ as Toronto, Canada (no street address).

name: Reeple.ai
description: Financial services platform helping African immigrants in the diaspora access banking and financial services.
notes: HQ Brampton per CB Insights; Techstars board lists Toronto, Brampton and Lagos. Seed stage per Techstars board; CB Insights reports about USD 270K raised. Techstars Toronto 2023 cohort.

name: ResQ
description: Commercial repair and maintenance provider and SaaS-enabled marketplace connecting operators with on-demand service providers.
notes: Site lists offices in Miami, New York, Toronto and London without naming a HQ; Datanyze, ZoomInfo and Built In give Toronto HQ.
address: 18 King St E, Suite 1100, Toronto, ON M5C 1C4

name: RetiSpec
description: Developer of AI-driven early detection of Alzheimer's disease through a simple eye exam (research use only).
notes: Toronto per site title and CB Insights/The Logic; no street address on site.

name: Sprout Family
description: Digital health and benefits platform for fertility, surrogacy, adoption and family building, sold through employers.
notes: Pre-seed CAD 1.7M closed March 2025, led by StandUp Ventures (Osler; exact date not given). Toronto per Osler lead office and Techjobs; no address on site. The sproutfamily.ca domain was assumed from site content matching the fertility benefits description; sprout.family is a parked domain.
